none: PAS CAM-7ED0E2: Roman Coin : Copper alloy Nummus, House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Nummus, House of Constantine. Mint: Unclear AD 335-341 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads: GLOR[IA EXERCITVS]. Reverse: Two soldiers and one standard. Obverse legend: illegible. Obverse: Bust facing right. Die axis: 12 o'clock. Weight 1.72g, diameter 13.51mm
